en.title: Guardian consent for a young contributor
en.intro: {institution} runs {classroom}, a Global Classroom of the Da Grouper School programme. Students take weather, rain, soil and reef measurements and share them openly with researchers. Anyone under 18 needs a parent or guardian’s consent before they send any measurement.

sections.heading: What your child will do
sections.body: Take measurements with the classroom’s kit, with a facilitator present, and send them through the DaGrouper app.

sections.heading: What we keep
sections.body: The measurements and when they were taken. Your child’s name is never shown with their measurements. A position from their phone is rounded to {decimals} decimal places before it is stored.

sections.heading: Changing your mind
sections.body: You can withdraw consent at any time. Tell a facilitator at {institution} or fill in a new sheet. From then on, your child cannot send measurements.

choices.give: I give consent for my child to take part and send measurements.
choices.withdraw: I do not give consent, or I withdraw consent I gave before.

en.officeNote: For the classroom: keep this sheet. The institution head or a facilitator records it in the app under the classroom’s Consent tab.
